headers.scan_trace:
(vs : List ℕ) (es acc : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    Trace (transition vs) (scanSteps vs es) (.edges es acc)
      (.reverse ((value vs es).reverse++acc) [])
headers.reverse_trace:
(vs : List ℕ) (es out : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    Trace (transition vs) (es.length+1) (.reverse es out) (.halt (es.reverse++out))
headers.filter_trace:
(vs : List ℕ) (es : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    Trace (transition vs) (steps vs es) (.edges es []) (.halt (value vs es))
headers.edgeSteps_le: (vs : List ℕ) (e : StoredEdges.Edge) : edgeSteps vs e≤2*vs.length+5
headers.scanSteps_le:
(vs : List ℕ) (es : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    scanSteps vs es≤es.length*(2*vs.length+5)+1
headers.steps_le: (vs : List ℕ) (es : List StoredEdges.Edge) : steps vs es≤bound vs.length es.length
